query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE order_items SET deleted = TRUE WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO order_item_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($2, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $3, unnested.event_type, unnested.event FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($4::TEXT[], $5::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event) RETURNING recorded_at
